arabic text: YEH SOCHTA HUN KE ABID KA HALL KYA HOGA
english translation text: I AM WONDERING WHAT THE STATE OF ABID (IMAM SAJJAD) WOULD HAVE BEEN

arabic text: YEH SOCHTA HUN KE ABID KA HALL KYA HOGA,\nASEER HOKE WO JAB SHAAM MEIN GAYA HOGA
english translation text: I AM WONDERING WHAT THE STATE OF ABID (IMAM SAJJAD) WOULD HAVE BEEN,\nAFTER BEING A PRISONER HE WAS TAKEN TO SHAAM (DAMASCUS)

arabic text: SUNA HAI SHAAM MEIN JATEY HI KHOON RONE LAGA,\nNA JAANE SHIMR NE USS WAQT KYA KAHA HOGA
english translation text: I HAVE HEARD AFTER GOING TO SHAAM (DAMASCUS) HE CRIED TEARS OF BLOOD,\nNO ONE KNOWS WHAT SHIMR WOULD HAVE SAID TO HIM

arabic text: GALEY NE TAUQ NE ABID KO KYA JHUKANA THA,\nWHO APNE KHOYE HUWE LAAL DHOONDTA HOGA
english translation text: WHAT PAIN WOULD ABID (IMAM SAJJAD) HAVE SUFFERED WHILST WEARING A COLLAR OF IRON AROUND HIS NECK,\nHE MUST HAVE BEEN LOOKING FOR HIS LOST BELOVED

arabic text: WO ZULM DEIKHEY HAIN SAJJAD NE HUSSAIN KE BAAD,\nMUJHE YAQEEN HAI KE AB TAK BHI RO RAHA HOGA
english translation text: WHAT PAIN AND SUFFERING DID SAJJAD FACE AFTER HUSSAIN’S [DEATH],\nI AM SURE THAT HE WILL BE WEEPING TO THIS DAY

arabic text: WO YAAD KARTA TO HOGA WATAN KI SHAAHI KO,\nBAHEN KO DAFN JO PARDEIS MEIN KYA HOGA
english translation text: HE MUST HAVE BEEN REMEMBERING HIS ROYAL CITY [MEDINA],\nWHAT WOULD HE HAVE FELT BY BURYING HIS SISTER AWAY FROM HOME (I.E. IN SHAAM)

arabic text: JO GHAUR KEEJEY TO ABID BASHAR NAHI LAGTA,\nMERE KHYAAL MEIN DUKH DARD KA KHUDA HOGA
english translation text: UPON REFLECTION HIS PATIENCE SEEMS TO BE BEYOND CAPACITY,\nIN MY (POET) VIEW HE IS THE MASTER OF THE ENDURANCE AND FORBEARANCE
